periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Diagonal orientation approximately 60 degrees relative to the horizontal axis, tapering toward the muzzle.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval morphology with a visual height significantly exceeding the width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced tapering toward the ventral point, creating a teardrop effect below the geometric center.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide horizontal separation across the white cranial expanse, roughly 1.5 times the width of a single pinna.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smooth, continuous semicircular curvature at the apex of both ears.

other_distinctive_markers: Extensive brown-hued staining/discoloration of the ventral fur on the chest and abdominal region.
